look_here_first: Ignore ray color first. Look for very narrow rough leaves and a usually single head on a stout little-branched stem, with drooping rays around a hard prickly cone.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: narrow linear-lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate rough/hairy leaves

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: stems stout and usually simple or weakly branched, often one head

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: ray florets often droop around a broad hard prickly conical disk

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: pappus much reduced compared with fluffy Asteraceae

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Deep-rooted perennial, usually not a spreading rhizomatous colony.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Radiate head with pink-purple rays around strongly conical prickly disk.

key_traits.label: Reproductive detail
key_traits.text: Stiff chaff/bracts among disk florets create the prickly cone.
